terms.definition: Stage is Prospecting or Engaging (not Won and not Lost).
Open pipeline closing in a period divided by quota for that period. We report total coverage; weighted coverage is not defined yet.
Palo Alto Networks' fiscal year starts August 1, so FY27-Q1 is Aug 1 to Oct 31, 2026 (assumption until confirmed).
The fiscal quarter containing the data snapshot's as-of date.
Central, East or West: the regional office of the sales rep who owns the deal.
Open deals have no value in the source data, so the list price of the product is used.
A contact whose job title starts with "Chief", for example Chief Information Security Officer or Chief Technology Officer. Only engagement by a CXO fires the CXO alert.

ambiguousTerms.weighted: Do you mean total coverage (open pipeline / quota)? Weighted coverage is not defined in the metric registry yet.

businessRules.rule: The fiscal year starts August 1. FY27-Q1 is August 1 to October 31, 2026, and FY27-Q2 is November 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027. "This quarter" is the quarter containing the snapshot's as-of date.
A deal is open when its stage is Prospecting or Engaging. Won and Lost deals are closed and never count toward pipeline or open deals.
A deal belongs to the region of the sales rep who owns it: Central, East or West. There are no other regions.
Open deals have no value in the source data, so the product's list price is used and the amount is marked as an estimate.
An open deal with no close date is expected to close one median sales cycle after it was engaged. If that date has already passed, it rolls forward 0 to 59 days from the snapshot date.
Quota is synthetic: 1.2 times each rep's average quarterly won revenue over the last four quarters, rounded to $1,000. A team's quota is the sum of its reps' quotas.
Where there is no quota, coverage is not available. It is never shown as zero and is left out of rankings and charts.
A CXO is a contact whose job title starts with "Chief". Only engagement by a CXO fires the CXO alert.
Every answer comes from the newest data snapshot and states its as-of date.

A follow-up keeps the earlier filters and breakdown only when it names no metric ("what about West?") or names the same metric with a follow-up word ("and the open pipeline by stage?"). Naming a different metric starts a new question.

Open pipeline and open opportunity count can be filtered by deal size, product or series, account, sector, and the sales rep who owns the deal. Pipeline coverage can be filtered by that rep, because quota is per rep. It cannot be filtered by deal size, product, account or sector, because quota is not split that way. An unknown name is asked about, not dropped.
